team.summary: Co-founders Sourabh Gupta (CEO) and Akshay Deshraj (CTO) founded Skit.ai in 2016. Both have IIT Roorkee backgrounds; Sourabh is a Forbes 30U30 honoree. The team has deep domain experience in voice AI for contact centers, accumulated over 8+ years. No prior startup exits are known. Technical depth is implied by Akshay's CTO role and the company's long-standing AI focus, but exact ownership of core models is not verifiable from provided sources.
